# What every NIDS module needs, whichever modules are selected. Module-specific packages
# live in assignments/registry.toml under [<CODE>.environment].extra; `nids-setup.py env`
# unions the two. Keep this list short.

jupyterlab
ipykernel

# `nids-setup.py verify` executes notebooks with this. jupyterlab already pulls it in, so
# it costs nothing -- named here so verify does not break the day that stops being true.
nbclient

# nids_registry needs TOML support; Python 3.11+ has tomllib and never imports this.
tomli; python_version < "3.11"
